title: Session detail screen: transcript tab, formatter and share
description: Show a session's transcript with timestamps and speaker labels, and share it as text (goals 2, 3). This screen gets Summary and Ask tabs in later tasks.
steps: Create `data/TranscriptFormatter.kt`: `data class TranscriptLine(val startMs: Long, val speaker: String?, val text: String)`, `object TranscriptFormatter { fun timestamp(ms: Long): String; fun lines(segments: List<SegmentEntity>, speakers: List<SpeakerEntity>): List<TranscriptLine>; fun toText(lines: List<TranscriptLine>): String }`. timestamp: `mm:ss`, or `h:mm:ss` ≥ 1 h. lines: speaker label from the SpeakerEntity with matching index, `null` when speakerIndex is null. toText: one line per segment `"[mm:ss] Label: text"` or `"[mm:ss] text"` without speaker, joined by `\n`; consecutive lines from the same speaker are NOT merged.

Create `ui/session/SessionViewModel.kt`: constructor `(sessionId: Long, repository: SessionRepository)`; `val uiState: StateFlow<SessionUiState>` combining `observe(id)`, segments and speakers: `data class SessionUiState(val title: String = "", val status: SessionStatus? = null, val lines: List<TranscriptLine> = emptyList(), val speakers: List<SpeakerEntity> = emptyList(), val notFound: Boolean = false)`. `fun transcriptText(): String` = `TranscriptFormatter.toText(uiState.value.lines)`.

Create `ui/session/SessionScreen.kt` for route `session/{id}` (replace the placeholder; `navArgument("id") { type = NavType.LongType }`). Top bar: title, back arrow, share icon (`Icons.Filled.Share`) launching `Intent.createChooser(Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND).setType("text/plain").putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_SUBJECT, title).putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_TEXT, transcriptText), null)`. Under it a `PrimaryTabRow` with tabs "Transcript", "Summary", "Ask" (Summary/Ask show "Coming soon" for now). Transcript tab: a status banner ("Identifying speakers…" with `LinearProgressIndicator` for DIARIZING, "Speaker detection failed" for DIARIZATION_FAILED), then a `LazyColumn`: each line shows timestamp + speaker label in `labelMedium` (speaker colored by index from a fixed palette of 6 colors) and the text in `bodyLarge`. Empty transcript: "No speech was recognised."
acceptanceCriteria: Test: `toText` gives `"[00:00] Speaker 1: Hello\n[00:03] Speaker 2: Hi"` for two labelled segments and `"[00:00] Hello"` when unlabelled
Test: renaming a speaker in the DB updates `uiState.lines` labels (flow re-emits)
Test: an unknown session id gives `notFound == true`
`source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug` exits 0
